mkdir -p /tmp/fig60 && cat > /tmp/fig60/gen.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, math, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "archive")
from terrain_frame_glyph import terrain_frame

INK, MUT, FAINT, ACC, OCH = "#111111", "#6b6a60", "#9b998c", "#8c2f1f", "#8a6a1e"
FONT = "Palatino,Georgia,serif"
H = 480
IC = 176
LOSS_Y = H - 44

def txt(x, y, s, size=10, color=MUT, w=400, anchor="middle", style="", tid=None):
    tid_attr = f"id='{tid}' " if tid else ""
    return (f"<text {tid_attr}x='{x:.1f}' y='{y:.1f}' font-family='{FONT}' font-size='{size}' "
            f"fill='{color}' font-weight='{w}' text-anchor='{anchor}' {style}>{s}</text>")

def cap(xc, y, name, sub=None, color=MUT, name_color=None):
    out = [txt(xc, y, name, 10.5, name_color or (INK if color == MUT else color), 600)]
    if sub:
        out.append(txt(xc, y + 12, sub, 9.5, color))
    return "".join(out)

def harrow(x1, x2, y, label=None, color=FAINT):
    out = [f"<line x1='{x1}' y1='{y}' x2='{x2 - 5}' y2='{y}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1'/>",
           f"<path d='M {x2},{y} l -6,-3 v 6 Z' fill='{color}'/>"]
    if label:
        out.append(txt((x1 + x2) / 2, y - 6, label, 9, FAINT, style="font-style='italic'"))
    return "".join(out)

def leader(x1, y1, x2, y2, color):
    return (f"<line x1='{x1}' y1='{y1}' x2='{x2}' y2='{y2}' stroke='{color}' "
            f"stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='2 4'/>")

def orth_leader(x1, y1, x2, y2, color):
    """Orthogonal L-route dashed leader (through empty lanes, not diagonal)."""
    ymid = y1 + (y2 - y1) * 0.55
    return (f"<path d='M {x1},{y1} V {ymid} H {x2} V {y2}' fill='none' stroke='{color}' "
            f"stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='2 4'/>")

def slab(x, s, d, color=INK, yc=None):
    yc = IC if yc is None else yc
    y = yc - s / 2
    dx, dy = d, d * 0.55
    out = [
        f"<polygon points='{x},{y} {x+dx},{y-dy} {x+dx+s},{y-dy} {x+s},{y}' "
        f"fill='#00000010' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1'/>",
        f"<polygon points='{x+s},{y} {x+dx+s},{y-dy} {x+dx+s},{y-dy+s} {x+s},{y+s}' "
        f"fill='#0000001c' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1'/>",
        f"<rect x='{x}' y='{y}' width='{s}' height='{s}' fill='#00000006' "
        f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.2'/>",
    ]
    return "".join(out), s + dx

def bar(x, h, color=INK, ticks=9, yc=None):
    yc = IC if yc is None else yc
    y = yc - h / 2
    out = [f"<rect x='{x}' y='{y}' width='7' height='{h}' fill='none' "
           f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.2'/>"]
    for i in range(1, ticks):
        out.append(f"<line x1='{x}' y1='{y + i * h / ticks:.1f}' x2='{x + 7}' "
                   f"y2='{y + i * h / ticks:.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.5' opacity='0.5'/>")
    return "".join(out), 7

def fan(x1, h1, x2, h2, color=FAINT, n=5, yc=None):
    yc = IC if yc is None else yc
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        ya = yc - h1 / 2 + (i + 0.5) * h1 / n
        for j in range(n):
            yb = yc - h2 / 2 + (j + 0.5) * h2 / n
            out.append(f"<line x1='{x1}' y1='{ya:.1f}' x2='{x2}' y2='{yb:.1f}' "
                       f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.5' opacity='0.45'/>")
    return "".join(out)

def gridsq(x, s, n, color=INK, bumps=(), yc=None, lw=1.2):
    yc = IC if yc is None else yc
    y = yc - s / 2
    out = [f"<rect x='{x}' y='{y}' width='{s}' height='{s}' fill='none' "
           f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='{lw}'/>"]
    for i in range(1, n):
        out.append(f"<line x1='{x + i * s / n:.1f}' y1='{y}' x2='{x + i * s / n:.1f}' "
                   f"y2='{y + s}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.45' opacity='0.5'/>")
        out.append(f"<line x1='{x}' y1='{y + i * s / n:.1f}' x2='{x + s}' "
                   f"y2='{y + i * s / n:.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.45' opacity='0.5'/>")
    for (gx, gy, o) in bumps:
        out.append(f"<rect x='{x + gx * s / n:.1f}' y='{y + gy * s / n:.1f}' "
                   f"width='{s / n:.1f}' height='{s / n:.1f}' fill='{color}' fill-opacity='{o}'/>")
    return "".join(out), s

BUMP = ((5, 2, .55), (4, 2, .28), (5, 1, .28), (6, 2, .18), (5, 3, .18), (2, 5, .12), (1, 6, .1))

def crosspt(x, y, color, r=7):
    return (f"<line x1='{x - r}' y1='{y}' x2='{x + r}' y2='{y}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.4'/>"
            f"<line x1='{x}' y1='{y - r}' x2='{x}' y2='{y + r}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.4'/>"
            f"<circle cx='{x}' cy='{y}' r='{r * 0.55:.1f}' fill='none' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.4'/>"
            f"<circle cx='{x}' cy='{y}' r='1.5' fill='{color}'/>")

def converge(gx, gs, tx, ty, color, n=8):
    out = []
    y0 = IC - gs / 2
    src = []
    for gyy in range(n):
        for gxx in range(n):
            if (gxx + gyy) % 2:
                continue
            src.append((gx + (gxx + 0.5) * gs / n, y0 + (gyy + 0.5) * gs / n))
    for (sx, sy) in src:
        out.append(f"<line x1='{sx:.0f}' y1='{sy:.0f}' x2='{tx}' y2='{ty}' "
                   f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.55' opacity='0.4'/>")
    out.append(crosspt(tx, ty, color))
    return "".join(out)

def gauge(x, yc, color=MUT, r=14):
    a = math.radians(55)
    return (f"<path d='M {x - r},{yc} A {r} {r} 0 0 1 {x + r},{yc}' fill='none' "
            f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.2'/>"
            f"<line x1='{x}' y1='{yc}' x2='{x + (r - 3) * math.cos(a):.1f}' "
            f"y2='{yc - (r - 3) * math.sin(a):.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.4'/>"
            f"<circle cx='{x}' cy='{yc}' r='1.6' fill='{color}'/>")

def kernel_proj(x1, s1, x2, s2, color, yc=None):
    yc = IC if yc is None else yc
    k = max(5, s1 * 0.30)
    kx, ky = x1 + s1 * 0.60, yc - s1 / 2 + s1 * 0.18
    c = max(3, s2 * 0.14)
    cx, cy = x2 + s2 * 0.22, yc - s2 / 2 + s2 * 0.26
    out = [f"<rect x='{kx:.1f}' y='{ky:.1f}' width='{k:.1f}' height='{k:.1f}' "
           f"fill='none' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.9'/>",
           f"<rect x='{cx:.1f}' y='{cy:.1f}' width='{c:.1f}' height='{c:.1f}' "
           f"fill='{color}' fill-opacity='0.5' stroke='none'/>"]
    for (px, py) in ((kx, ky), (kx + k, ky), (kx, ky + k), (kx + k, ky + k)):
        out.append(f"<line x1='{px:.1f}' y1='{py:.1f}' x2='{cx + c / 2:.1f}' "
                   f"y2='{cy + c / 2:.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.55' "
                   f"opacity='0.45'/>")
    return "".join(out)

def frame_part():
    g = terrain_frame(IC - 38)
    out = (g + txt(53, IC - 44, "128²×3", 9, FAINT)
           + txt(53, IC + 48, "camera frame", 10.5, MUT, 600)
           + txt(53, IC + 60, "one night exposure", 9.5, FAINT)
           + txt(53, IC + 73, "frozen contract", 8.5, FAINT,
                 style="font-style='italic'"))
    return out, 26 + 76

def output_part(x, sub="position fix + confidence"):
    return (txt(x, IC - 18, "frozen contract", 8.5, FAINT, anchor="start",
                style="font-style='italic'")
            + txt(x, IC - 2, "(lat, lon, confidence)", 13, MUT, 600, "start",
                  tid="frozen-output")
            + txt(x, IC + 12, sub, 9, FAINT, anchor="start"))

def lanes():
    return (txt(8, 26, "INFERENCE PATH — WHAT FLIES", 9, FAINT, 600, "start",
                "letter-spacing='1.8'")
            + txt(8, LOSS_Y - 34, "TRAINING & EXPORT — NEVER FLIES", 9, OCH, 600, "start",
                  "letter-spacing='1.8'"))

def svgwrap(body):
    return (f"<svg viewBox='0 0 980 {H}' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' role='img'>"
            f"{body}</svg>")

def rot_icon(cx0, cy0, color, s=16):
    out = []
    for i, ang in enumerate((0, 30, 60, 90)):
        out.append(f"<rect x='{cx0 - s/2}' y='{cy0 - s/2}' width='{s}' height='{s}' "
                    f"fill='none' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1' opacity='{0.3+i*0.18:.2f}' "
                    f"transform='rotate({ang} {cx0} {cy0})'/>")
    r = s * 1.15
    out.append(f"<path d='M {cx0-r},{cy0} A {r} {r} 0 0 1 {cx0+r},{cy0}' fill='none' "
                f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1'/>"
                f"<path d='M {cx0+r},{cy0+5} l -3,-5.5 h 5.5 Z' fill='{color}'/>")
    return "".join(out)

b = [lanes()]

# ---- camera frame (frozen) ----
g, x = frame_part(); b.append(g)
b.append(harrow(x + 6, x + 30, IC)); x += 32

# ---- rotation ensemble icon (mechanism unchanged: still 4x C4 stack) ----
rx = x + 14
b.append(rot_icon(rx, IC - 30, INK))
b.append(cap(rx, IC - 6, "C4 stack", "4 rotated views, same trunk/head", color=MUT))
x += 30
b.append(harrow(x + 6, x + 26, IC)); x += 30

# ---- trunk group: 5-stage from-scratch QAT conv trunk (CHANGED) ----
trunk_x0 = x
sizes = [(44, 7), (34, 10), (26, 14), (19, 18), (19, 21)]
faces = []
prev = (26, 76, FAINT)
for i, (s, d) in enumerate(sizes):
    gsvg, w = slab(x, s, d, ACC)
    b.append(gsvg)
    faces.append((x, s))
    x += w + 15
x -= 15
b.append(kernel_proj(prev[0], prev[1], faces[0][0], faces[0][1], FAINT))
for (x1, s1), (x2, s2) in zip(faces, faces[1:]):
    b.append(kernel_proj(x1, s1, x2, s2, ACC))
trunk_xend = x
trunk_xc = (trunk_x0 + trunk_xend) / 2
b.append(cap(trunk_xc, IC + 62, "from-scratch QAT conv trunk", "5-stage, 3→224 ch · ~700k–1.0M params",
             color=ACC, name_color=ACC))
b.append(txt(trunk_x0 + 25, IC - 30, "64²×32", 9, FAINT))
b.append(txt(trunk_xend - 16, IC - 26, "8²×224", 9, FAINT))

# quantization staircase glyph under first stage
qx, qy = trunk_x0 + 4, IC + 84
steps = [(0,10),(5,7),(10,4),(15,1)]
path = f"M {qx},{qy+10}"
for i,(dx,dy) in enumerate(steps):
    path += f" H {qx+dx+5} V {qy+dy}"
b.append(f"<path d='{path}' fill='none' stroke='{ACC}' stroke-width='1.2'/>")
b.append(txt(qx + 32, IC + 92, "INT8 fake-quant (STE), every fwd pass", 9, ACC, anchor="start"))

# ---- FiLM branch (CHANGED): luminance -> tiny MLP -> gamma/beta into trunk's last stage ----
film_yc = 58
lx = trunk_x0 + 90
g2, _ = bar(lx, 16, ACC, ticks=1, yc=film_yc)
b.append(g2)
b.append(txt(lx + 3, film_yc - 16, "mean luminance", 9, ACC))
hx = lx + 34
g3, _ = bar(hx, 26, ACC, ticks=4, yc=film_yc)
b.append(fan(lx, 16, hx, 26, ACC, n=3, yc=film_yc)); b.append(g3)
gx2 = hx + 40
g4, _ = bar(gx2, 20, ACC, ticks=2, yc=film_yc)
b.append(fan(hx, 26, gx2, 20, ACC, n=3, yc=film_yc)); b.append(g4)
b.append(txt(gx2 + 3, film_yc - 16, "γ, β", 10, ACC, 600))
last_x, last_s = faces[-1]
film_tx, film_ty = last_x + last_s * 0.55, IC - last_s / 2
b.append(orth_leader(gx2 + 3, film_yc + 12, film_tx, film_ty, ACC))
b.append(cap((lx + gx2) / 2 + 10, film_yc + 26, "FiLM conditioning", "γ·x + β on trunk feature map",
             color=ACC, name_color=ACC))

b.append(harrow(trunk_xend + 8, trunk_xend + 32, IC)); x = trunk_xend + 34

# ---- GAP descriptor (mechanism unchanged, new width) ----
gap_x = x
g5, _ = bar(gap_x, 64, INK, ticks=13)
b.append(g5)
b.append(cap(gap_x + 4, IC + 46, "224-d vector", "global avg pool"))

# ---- layout squeeze -> layout code (CHANGED: re-derived for new channels) ----
lsq_yc = IC + 100
lsq_x = gap_x - 6
g6, lw6 = gridsq(lsq_x, 30, 6, ACC, ((3,2,.5),(2,3,.3)), yc=lsq_yc, lw=1)
b.append(g6)
b.append(cap(lsq_x + 15, lsq_yc + 26, "layout code", "1×1 QATConv squeeze, 16×8×8", color=ACC, name_color=ACC))
concat_x = gap_x + 20
b.append(orth_leader(lsq_x + 15, lsq_yc - 15, concat_x, IC + 30, ACC))

# concat + fan to single field head
fx = gap_x + 30
combh = 92
g7, _ = bar(fx + 46, combh, ACC, ticks=15)
b.append(fan(gap_x, 64, fx + 46, combh, ACC, n=5))
b.append(g7)
b.append(cap(fx + 50, IC + 46, "FC → 1024 logits", "single field head", color=ACC, name_color=ACC))
b.append(txt(fx + 50, IC + 70, "(no dark-expert head, no gate blend)", 8.5, ACC, style="font-style='italic'"))

x = fx + 60
b.append(harrow(x, x + 26, IC)); gx3 = x + 28
g8, gs8 = gridsq(gx3, 76, 8, ACC, BUMP)
b.append(g8)
b.append(cap(gx3 + 38, IC + 56, "probability field", "32×32 cells over the map", color=ACC, name_color=ACC))

# ---- confidence-weighted ensemble combine (CHANGED: was plain mean) ----
wy = IC - 66
wx0 = gx3 + 6
weights = [10, 16, 7, 13]
for i, wv in enumerate(weights):
    wxx = wx0 + i * 11
    b.append(f"<rect x='{wxx}' y='{wy - wv}' width='7' height='{wv}' fill='{ACC}' fill-opacity='0.35' "
              f"stroke='{ACC}' stroke-width='0.8'/>")
    b.append(f"<line x1='{wxx+3.5}' y1='{wy}' x2='{gx3+38}' y2='{IC-38}' stroke='{ACC}' stroke-width='0.6' opacity='0.5'/>")
b.append(cap(wx0 + 20, wy - 26, "confidence-weighted avg", "4 views, weighted by own peak mass (was: plain mean)",
             color=ACC, name_color=ACC))

# ---- decode: soft-argmax (unchanged formula) ----
tx = 812
b.append(converge(gx3, gs8, tx, IC, INK))
b.append(cap((gx3 + gs8 + tx) / 2 + 4, IC - 54, "soft-argmax over ALL cells", "answer = Σ probability · cell-center"))
b.append(output_part(828))

# ---- confidence branch (CHANGED: rebuilt for 224-d descriptor) ----
cbx = gap_x + 4
b.append(orth_leader(cbx, IC + 64, cbx, IC + 118, ACC))
b.append(gauge(cbx, IC + 132, ACC))
b.append(txt(cbx, IC + 150, "confidence 0–1", 9, ACC))
ex = tx + 18
b.append(f"<path d='M {cbx + 18},{IC+132} H {ex} V {IC + 26}' fill='none' stroke='{ACC}' stroke-width='0.8'/>")
b.append(f"<path d='M {ex},{IC + 20} l -3,6 h 6 Z' fill='{ACC}'/>")
b.append(cap((cbx+ex)/2 - 10, IC + 166, "conf_head rebuilt", "peak mass, entropy, sharp/unsharp gap, detached 224-d descriptor",
             color=ACC, name_color=ACC))

# ---- training / export lane ----
# training data (unchanged sampler)
tdx = gx3 + 10
b.append(orth_leader(gx3 + 38, IC + 92, tdx, LOSS_Y - 30, OCH))
b.append(txt(tdx, LOSS_Y - 20, "confusability-weighted place sampler (exp-35, unchanged)", 9.5, OCH, anchor="start"))

# training procedure (changed: single Adam group, freeze step)
tpx = trunk_xc - 40
b.append(orth_leader(trunk_xc, IC + 100, tpx, LOSS_Y - 8, ACC))
b.append(txt(tpx, LOSS_Y - 8, "single Adam group @ 1e-3 (no trunk/head LR split — no pretrained trunk to protect)",
             10, ACC, 600, anchor="start"))
b.append(txt(tpx, LOSS_Y + 6, "same Gaussian-CE + L2 + conf BCE, computed under live weight fake-quantization",
             9.5, OCH, anchor="start"))

# deployment quantization export step (changed)
dqx = 600
b.append(orth_leader(tx, IC + 26, dqx, LOSS_Y - 8, ACC))
b.append(txt(dqx, LOSS_Y - 8, "freeze_quantized_weights() → FP32 ONNX → quantize_dynamic (INT8 weight-only)",
             10, ACC, 600, anchor="start"))
b.append(txt(dqx, LOSS_Y + 6, "shipped {area}.onnx, target ~2.2–3.2 MiB of the 4 MiB gate",
             9.5, ACC, anchor="start"))

svg = svgwrap("".join(b))
out = {"architecture_svg": svg}
with open("/tmp/fig60/out.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(out, f)
print("bytes", len(svg))
